dct_title_s: Hennepin Ave. & Lyndale Ave. grade separation : proposed improvement plan

dct_description_sm: Plan for intersection of Hennepin Avenue & Lyndale Avenue shows roads, sewers, storm drains, and streetcar tracks.; Oriented with north toward the lower left.; Relief shown pictorially.; "Works Progress Administration Project 1968."; "Loye W. Chandler, Supervising Eng. C. A. Princell, Delineator."; "C. E. Princell. Revised: 5-15-,1935."; Includes two profiles, details, two sections, and two transverse sections.
